title: Courtesy Reissue of Expired Kestrel Cash — Kestrel Care Rewards
content:
**Rule.** At a **Kestrel Care Rewards** level where the courtesy reissue of expired Kestrel Cash is allowed, an expired Kestrel Cash reward is reissued once, as a courtesy reissue with a fresh validity period, when both of the following hold:

1. the patient asks no later than the date the reward expired plus the level's cash reissue window days, counted in calendar days with the expiry date as day 0 — the last day of the window still qualifies; and
2. the number of courtesy reissues on the membership in the rolling 365 calendar days ending on, and including, the day of the request is below the level's reissue allowance.

The date the reward expired is the date on the system's expiry entry for that reward, and the reissue is tied to that same expired reward.

## Reissue terms by level

| Level | Courtesy reissue of expired Kestrel Cash | Reissue window (calendar days after the expiry date) | Courtesy reissues allowed in any rolling 365 days |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Member | not allowed | 0 | 0 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Silver | not allowed | 0 | 0 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | allowed | 14 | 1 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | allowed | 30 | 2 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly | allowed | 30 | 2 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual | allowed | 30 | 2 |

## Window arithmetic (hypothetical dates)

| Reward expired on (day 0) | Window | Last day to ask | Asked on the last day | Asked the day after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 August | 14 days | 24 August | within the window | outside the window |
| 10 August | 30 days | 9 September | within the window | outside the window |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical memberships)

| Membership | Request | Outcome under the rule |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold, no courtesy reissue in the last 365 days | asked 12 days after the expiry date | both conditions hold: reissued as a courtesy reissue with a fresh validity period |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold, 1 courtesy reissue in the last 365 days | asked 5 days after the expiry date | 1 is not below the allowance of 1: condition 2 fails |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum, 1 courtesy reissue in the last 365 days | asked 30 days after the expiry date | 1 is below 2 and day 30 is the window's last day: both conditions hold |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Silver | any request | the level does not allow a courtesy reissue |

**Once per reward.** An expired reward is reissued once; a reward that has already been reissued as a courtesy is not reissued again.
